title: Confirm result writes before announcing success
test_file_status: planned new file in existing tests/voice lane

evidence.observed: With sample SYNTH-A active, record_result returning {success:false,error:'rejected'} still produces 'Result 7 recorded for pH on sample SYNTH-A.'.

user_impact: A technician hears that a result was saved even when the mocked server response explicitly says success=false.
implementation_scope: Validate the returned acknowledgment before claiming persistence. Treat explicit rejection, missing/empty or malformed acknowledgment as unconfirmed. Do not automatically retry writes whose outcome is unknown.
acceptance: A rejected or malformed acknowledgment never says recorded.
Confirmed persistence has truthful feedback; distinguish request acceptance from verified persistence.
Exactly one write attempt per command; preserve the active sample on uncertainty.
constraints: Change only the named source file and test file for implementation.
All verification uses synthetic fixtures and mocks; no live SENAITE writes or email.
Do not run jobs sharing a source file as concurrent writers.
